title: 寻找旋转排序数组中的最小值
statement: 一个元素互不相同、长度为 n 的升序数组被旋转了 1 到 n 次（每次把末尾元素移到开头），得到数组 nums。返回 nums 中的最小元素。

en.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
en.statement: An ascending array of length n with distinct elements has been rotated between 1 and n times (each rotation moves the last element to the front), producing nums. Return the minimum element of nums.
constraints: nums is an ascending array rotated 1 to n times

complexity.officialRequirement: Official requirement: O(log n) time complexity.
complexity.notes: n is the array length. Compare nums[mid] with nums[hi]: if nums[mid] > nums[hi], the minimum is in the right half; otherwise it is in [lo, mid]. Rotating n times is the same as no rotation. The local judge needs O(n) to read input, so running time cannot distinguish binary search from a linear scan.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is n; line 2 has n integers nums. stdout: one integer, the minimum value.

constraints: nums 是某个升序数组旋转 1 到 n 次后的结果

complexity.officialRequirement: 官方要求 O(log n) 时间复杂度。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度。比较 nums[mid] 与 nums[hi]：nums[mid] > nums[hi] 说明最小值在右半边，否则在 [lo, mid]。旋转 n 次等价于未旋转。本地判题需 O(n) 读入，无法从耗时上区分二分与线性扫描。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个整数 nums。stdout：一个整数，最小值。
